response.original_title: Of The Trees - Live at Camp Alderwild 2025 (Night 2 Full Set)
response.overview: Set against the breathtaking backdrop of the San Juan Mountains in Telluride, Colorado, electronic music innovator Of The Trees debuts his curated camping festival, Camp Alderwild. This concert film captures the immersive performance from the event's second night, blending deep bass design, cutting-edge visual arts, and intricate laser displays with the raw beauty of the natural wilderness. The performance chronicles a sonic journey where nature and experimental electronic music converge, creating a transformative communal experience.
response.tagline: Where nature and deep bass converge.
